adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `parseRefreshTokenResponse()` which, in sharing mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`), validates with `minimumTokenResponseSchema`. That schema only declares `access_token` plus two computed keys (`[z.string().toString()]`, etc.) rather than using `.catchall(...)`, so it will not preserve `refresh_token` (Zod object schemas strip unknown keys by default). The function then explicitly sets a missing `refresh_token` to the literal string `"refresh_token"`. In Zoom’s refresh flow, the code now uses `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseBody, zoomRefreshedTokenSchema)`, so under sharing mode the parsed token result will lose the real `refresh_token` and replace it with `"refresh_token"`, which would break subsequent refreshes if that parsed data is persisted as the credential key (as typical in these adapters).
